observer.method: Test-owned DLL in an isolated installation forwards to the unchanged installed runtime and wraps this process's DirectSound callbacks; real-device volume capped at -30 dB; only the current process's session meter is read

before: device unavailable, factory initialized 1, opened 1, query(-1) 0

after: device unavailable, factory initialized 1, opened 1, query(-1) 0
device available, factory initialized 1, opened 1, query(-1) 1
failureObservation.description: The standalone probe requires sound and therefore returns 3 for this deliberate audio failure, after all video frames complete

validation.linux: Ubuntu/Clang; framing, crop and RoQ cases also run with address/undefined sanitizers; native ABI is mocked

optionalProbe.outcome: Windows x86 build succeeds; German single-track fallback plus pause reproduces the 882000-byte PCM hash

limits: Observed installed Bink 1 runtime and default Windows audio device only
Some real-time recordings include native silent insertions; all other samples match, and exact real-time delivery is not claimed
PCM comparison precedes device attenuation, mixing and hardware conversion
Current-process output meter observes a delivered signal; it is not a subjective listening comparison
No microphone, system loopback recording, input control or OS screen capture
Proprietary movies and PCM remain local and are not committed

rendererValidationCorrection.reason: The probe used r_renderer, but the engine selector is cl_renderer. The retained Vulkan/RTX labels are intended cases, not observed backends.
